output.summary: Under policy V2025 bariatric surgery is covered only with BMI ≥40 and a six‑month supervised weight‑loss program. The claim provides a BMI record but lacks the supervised program record, leading to an EXCLUDED_SERVICE denial. Appeal is possible once the missing record is submitted.

items.text: A supervised weight‑loss program record (SUPERVISED_PROGRAM_RECORD) is required to satisfy the bariatric surgery coverage criteria.
Submit the SUPERVISED_PROGRAM_RECORD with the appeal to complete the required evidence set.
